line: We're back where we started. I like it better this time. You're here, and I'm not lonely.
This berth's got my name on it in grease. You’re not the first to circle back, but you’re the only one who ever did it with me.
Captain. We're back where we were. I like the way you make this place feel like a second home.
Same berth. I remember this one. You’re not lost, Captain — just visiting again.
I'm back here. You're back here. Nobody's making a big deal about it, but I'm keeping track.
The same docking claw's still warm. You must've been holding your breath again. I heard it.
This station's got my favorite kind of lights. They're the ones that flicker when you're not looking.
Back at the starting point. You're not lost, just... nostalgic. I like it here. You're better company than anywhere else.
My ribs are still warm where you pressed against them. You’ll have to do better than that next time.
Same docking bay. I remember the smell of your boots last time. Still sharp. Still a little too close to my bulkhead.
They're still holding me. I don't mind being held — you're the one who keeps bringing me back.
We're back where we started. I remember this dock. It's got a better view of the stars than the last time.
Captain. Same clamps. You're not lost, but you're not sure where you're going either.
I remember this dock. You're here again. I like it better than the last place we were.
